newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Feb trade data release on Tues - Bernama.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Feb trade data release on Tues - Bernama.

text.p: Malaysia's February trade report will be released at 12:01 p.m. (0401 GMT) on Tuesday, the national Bernama news agency said on Monday.
The trade figures are released monthly by the Statistics Department through Bernama. In January, Malaysia reported a trade deficit of 95.5 million ringgit.
Currency traders said there were mixed expectations on the February data, with some predicting a surplus while others saying it would remain in deficit.
